address: 252/21 Soi Wilai Sena, Prasoet Som Road, Sena, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13110, Thailand
bio: Set in Sena district's old market, this charming wooden house backs onto the River Noi. The relaxed atmosphere and delicious food make it a local favourite, with popular dishes like stir-fried river prawns with salt and pepper, and deep-fried fish with fish sauce....
